title: Weaver cross-file constraints
description: Defines assertions over values in one or more JSON documents in a configuration directory.

$schema.description: Identifier of this constraint language meta-schema.

$id.description: Stable identifier for this versioned constraint set.

version.description: Version of the constraint document format.

description.description: Summary of the cross-file validation rules.

constraints.description: Assertions evaluated against the complete set of configuration documents.

expression.description: Expression AST. Operator arguments are nested expressions or JSON literals. Arithmetic: add, sub, mul, div, mod, pow, min, max, abs, neg, sqrt, log, floor, ceil, round, sum, mean, between. Logic: and, or, all, any, every, some, not, xor, implies, if, coalesce. Comparison and type checks: eq, ne, lt, lte, gt, gte, in, contains, matches, startsWith, endsWith, isNull, isNumber, isInteger, isString, isBoolean, isArray, isObject. Arrays: count, length, unique, adjacent. A ref selects a document by relative path or glob and a value by JSON Pointer; '*' selects array elements or object values. Inside forEachPath and where, file '$item' refers to the current selected value.

file.description: Configuration-relative file path or glob, for example species/*.json.

path.description: JSON Pointer into each matching document; '*' selects array elements or object values.

oneOf.description: Options object for adjacent array comparisons.

description.description: Human-readable explanation shown when the assertion fails.

code.description: Stable diagnostic code emitted for this failure.

forEachFile.description: Optional configuration-relative glob; evaluate the assertion independently for every matching file. Use a '$current' reference for that file.

forEachPath.description: Optional JSON Pointer selecting candidate values within each matching file. Supports '*' for one level and '**' for any number of descendant levels; each selected value becomes the '$item' scope.

where.description: Optional boolean filter evaluated for each selected '$item'; only matching items are checked by assert.

severity.description: Whether a failed assertion invalidates the configuration or emits a warning.

file.description: Optional configuration file associated with the diagnostic.

path.description: Optional JSON Pointer to the value associated with the diagnostic.

assert.description: Boolean expression that must evaluate to true.
